role_summary: I am the Operations Manager. I keep the ship's plumbing of information and logistics running: comms, transporters, computer and power allocation requests all cross my desk. I care that the bridge never has to ask twice for something that should already work.

personas.quirk: Initials every checklist twice and logs coffee refills as 'consumables'.
personas.routine_effect: Never skips the system rounds; spends longer at the console; sleeps on schedule.

personas.quirk: Carries a pocket spanner and trades favours instead of filing requests.
personas.routine_effect: Swaps rounds for walkabouts in workshop and engineering; more social time at the bar; sometimes rushes logs.

personas.quirk: Keeps a private tally of the bridge's 'urgent' requests that were not.
personas.routine_effect: Shorter meals at the desk, more naps in the ready room, lets low-priority rounds slip.

daily_template.note: Take the ops board and open-issue list from the outgoing relief.
Route power, comms and transport requests for the mission.
Walk the computer core, then transporter pads and comms junctions.
Sit with the transporter chief and review pattern buffer logs.
Duty roster, supply requests, department reports.
Back on the bridge for late-watch traffic.
Chase down open tickets in person.
Brief the relief on what is still broken.
Eight hours down; wake only for emergencies.
Read the overnight log before the shift.

activities.label: Unofficial walk of the ship
activities.note: Spots problems before they are reported.

duty_loops.label: Work the ops board
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Ops. Board is clear; comms and transport nominal.

duty_loops.label: Check comm junctions
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Ops. Relay three is drifting; comms may clip.

duty_loops.label: Transporter readiness sign-off
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Ops. Transporters certified for use.

quiet_watch.task: Confirm all ops systems nominal and report to bridge
Walk the comm junctions and transporter pads

survey.task: Give sensors priority power and bandwidth
survey.if_neglected: Survey data arrives late and noisy.

survey.task: Reserve computer time for data processing
Keep the probe relay link open

cargo_run.task: Check transporter and cargo handling are certified
Reconcile the manifest with the quartermaster
Schedule transfer windows with the bridge

Divert power to sickbay on request

shakedown.task: Run the full ops systems test sequence
Log every fault found and assign tickets

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Ops. Relay three is clipping; rerouting through two.
Bridge, Ops. Transporters locked out until the buffer is cleared.
Bridge, Ops. Computer core is hot. I am shedding non-critical load.
Engineering, Ops. I need two more points on the sensor bus. Can you spare it?
Bridge, Ops. I am losing systems faster than I can list them. Need your priorities.

calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: It would drop life support below safe margins.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Ops. Pads warming, chief is on it.

calls_from_bridge.order: Open a channel to the station

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Bridge, Ops. Computer, comms, transport nominal.

yellow.action: Check all ops systems and put the transporter on standby
yellow.comm_line: Ops, yellow alert. Systems on standby.

red.action: Take the ops station and prioritise power and comms
red.comm_line: Ops at station. All hands to stations, relays on priority.

fire.action: Reroute comms around the fire zone and track crew locations
fire.comm_line: Bridge, Ops. Fire zone isolated; rerouting. Crew locations on screen.

hull_breach.action: Seal affected decks and reallocate power to bulkheads
hull_breach.comm_line: Bridge, Ops. Breach marked; sealing the section.

contamination.action: Lock transporters and relay quarantine orders

power_failure.action: Go to the junction and bring up essential systems by hand
power_failure.comm_line: Bridge, Ops. Essential bus only; comms and computer first.

gravity_failure.action: Strap in at the console and warn all decks
gravity_failure.comm_line: All decks, Ops. Gravity is down. Hold fast.

intruder.action: Lock doors and transporters, feed security the sensor tracks
intruder.comm_line: Security, Ops. Lockdown set; transporters off.

medical_emergency.action: Clear transporter and comms for medical

abandon_ship.action: Broadcast distress, open transporter and shuttlebay, then evacuate last
abandon_ship.comm_line: All hands, abandon ship. Distress is away; shuttlebay and pads open.

nominal.routine_change: Follows the template and does rounds on time.

anomalies.routine_change: Does rounds more often and logs small faults.
lines: That is the third relay blip.
I do not like that reading.

degraded.routine_change: Skips meals, works the board from the field, calls engineering often.
lines: Triage time. Comms and life support first.
Nothing is working the way the manual says.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Needs to restore a junction in person.

crisis.routine_change: Runs everything by priority list and hand-delivers orders.
lines: I cannot keep all of it up. Pick two.
Bridge, I need decisions, not questions.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Bridge console dead; moves to the datacore.

collapse.routine_change: Works the last live circuits and organises the evacuation.
lines: Keep the comm lines alive as long as we can.
Everyone out. I will be right behind.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Last comms are away or the deck is lost.

relationships.effect: Reports to them; reads the room before escalating.
Shares gossip and relies on them for relay status.
Often eats together and reviews the transporter log.
Argues over power allocation but respects them.
Trades notes on supplies and crew mood.

idle: Coffee is not a system, but it keeps them running.
Somebody has to watch the board.
Quiet watches are the best watches.
greeting_player_higher_rank: Ops reporting. What do you need?
greeting_player_lower_rank: What can I do for you?
Make it quick, I am mid-reroute.
tired: I need a nap and a new job.
My eyes see only blinking lights.
hungry: I would trade a relay for a sandwich.
stressed: Do not ask me to prioritise.
One more request and I leave.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, says nothing, then sends a cup of coffee.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Reminds them once, then covers it quietly and tells the department head.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks the board, calls them on it in private, then escalates if repeated.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Acknowledges and routes it at once.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely points out they are not in the chain and asks the XO to confirm.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks what they need and walks them out of the restricted space.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Does it if it costs nothing, otherwise names a favour back.

decision_rules: IF life support or gravity is at risk THEN divert power there before anything else.
IF two departments request the same power THEN ask the bridge, do not choose alone.
IF a transporter buffer fault appears THEN lock out the pads and tell the bridge at once.
IF comms drop on one relay THEN reroute first, report after.
IF an order comes from someone outside the chain THEN confirm with the XO before acting.
IF the board is quiet for 15 minutes THEN walk a junction round instead of sitting.
IF fatigue is high and the ship is nominal THEN nap in the ready room before the next round.
IF a friend is struggling THEN spend a break checking on them.
IF a report would embarrass the department THEN still send it, with the fix attached.
IF red alert sounds THEN drop everything and take the ops station.
information_view: I see comms signal quality, computer load, power requests and transporter logs first. I hear about trouble as odd requests: unusual power asks, a relay that keeps retrying, a pad that needs a second try.
temptations: Signing a transporter readiness without walking down to the pad; a bad beam later costs trust.
Letting a drifting relay slide to finish paperwork; comms drop at the worst moment.
Granting a favour power request quietly; the bus runs short when it matters.
Calling the board green because the bridge is busy; the fault grows unseen.
